title: Agents gained client tools and two community model routers
summary:
Agents gained client tools and smarter routing, Polli added coding harnesses, and the dashboard and app catalog got easier to use.

Prompt agents can now call functions defined by the client, then continue after the client returns results. Two new community agents route coding and code-review requests using model health, capabilities, and estimated cost. The hosted MCP audio transcription tool also works again for direct public audio URLs.

New Polli harness commands connect Codex and Claude Code through their supported routers, with model selection and setup-status checks. Polli also now returns reliable failure exit codes on Windows instead of aborting after certain fetch errors.

Dashboard pages keep their frame visible while loading, with one status indicator instead of scattered spinners. Sign-in actions are easier to reach, device-code validation is more precise, and authorization cards are easier to read. Model rows now show descriptions and clearer agent output labels without requiring an extra click.

highlights.title: Frugal code-agent routing
highlights.text: Call `community/fadyabohamza-netizen/frugal` to pick a low-cost, healthy model that can handle your context, images, and tools.

highlights.title: Code reviews with Prism
highlights.text: `cesus-agent/prism-code-review-router` matches review requests to fast, balanced, or deep models based on the diff, tool needs, and available budget.

highlights.title: Polli connects to Codex and Claude Code
highlights.text: Use `polli harness codex` or `polli harness claude-code` to route either tool through Pollinations, choose a model, and disconnect without changing your native login.

highlights.title: Prompt agents can call your tools
highlights.text: Give agents client-side functions alongside server-side MCP tools, then send the results back to continue the conversation. [API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)
